SBP: Lessen chance for future errors- discuss details for reporting/follow-up and what steps might be taken to decrease the risks of this happening again
ICS: Empathy- verbalize at least one empathetic statement during discussion of the events, make good eye contact and positive body language, inquire about the family member’s emotions and not interrupt.
Education- clearly state why the error occurred and its results/implications
Apology- use the phrase “I am sorry” during the disclosure
PROF: Honesty- explicitly state an error has occurred
